_note: Phase 4 prestige numbers (prestige.js). playerLevel: the account can prestige from this level (BO7: 55); playerMax: prestiges before the badge stops climbing. Weapons prestige at their own max level (attachments + 1). Prestige Master: masterXp weapon XP per Master level (a kill is 10, a headshot 15), up to masterMax; the animated Master camo comes at Master level masterCamoAt. Account Prestige Master (the prestige after playerMax): the level carries on from accountMasterStart to accountMasterCap at a flat accountMasterXp per level (about what level 55 costs on the normal curve); milestones are MASTER_MILESTONES in prestige.js.
